AST-HSP-001.glb_frame: Native glTF metres +Y up, source (x,y,z) converted once to (x,z,-y)
AST-HSP-001.status: Offline static compound proposal. Continuous source profile rows consolidated within a 5 mm radial chord bound. Bowed fascia split into source-backed vertical bands with at most 5 mm profile-depth infill; rails, slab, floor plinths, base shelf, higher shelf upstands, end bulkheads and radial supports remain distinct. Front rolled lips join their own shelf; drawer stays separate. Thin decorative ribs, reveal and drawer grip remain omitted. No engine physics or performance certification.
AST-HSP-001.approximation_note: All represented source triangles remain covered. Prior whole-fascia convexification is intentionally removed because it blocked real lower shelf depth. Arc consolidation and shelf/lip convexification can occupy nearby empty space; measured two-sided source-surface error and bounded access evidence are in qa/batch08/counter_collision_revision/validation_report.json.
